The '''Karnik Valley''' was located in the [[Ordan Spine Mountains]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]]. A [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crashed at the mouth of the valley and was buried deep within the fertile earth. As acres of forests burned around the crash site, an army of white armored soldiers led by a self name [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vasque Mirlan]] burned the villages of the valley as they moved out towards [[Vossport/Legends|Vossport]]. The armies of Vossport met the soldiers at the mouth of the valley, and while they were far outmatched by the more advanced weapons of the soldiers, they were eventually victorious when a [[Paladins of the Adamite Tower|group of Force-sensitives]] cut down the soldiers with ancient [[Lightsaber/Legends|sunfire swords]].<ref name="NoP" />
